exercises.prompt: Alaska is situated northwest of Canada.
exercises.why: If the verb of a sentence is transitive, the idea may be expressed in two ways: if we want to emphasize the performer of the action, we use the active voice; if we want to emphasize the object or target of the action, we express the same thought in the passive. *Студент купил книгу. — Книга куплена студентом.* In the passive construction the performer of the action is expressed by the instrumental case (студентом). The new relations are expressed in Russian by a special form of the verb which is called the short past passive participle (PPP). It is used only as a predicate in passive constructions.
